description: This file contains the implementation of the Lookup class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing lookup functions such as the primary lookup method used in spreadsheets.

classes.name: Lookup
classes.description: Provides static methods for performing lookup operations similar to Excel's lookup functions, including handling arrays and normal lookup operations.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs a lookup operation, searching for a value within a range or array, and returning a corresponding value from a result vector.

methods.name: verifyLookupValues
methods.description: Validates and prepares lookup vector values for matching, ensuring they are in the correct format for lookup.

methods.name: verifyResultVector
methods.description: Ensures the result vector is correctly oriented; if it's a row vector, it transposes it to a column vector.

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a given array.

methods.name: columnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in a given array.
